why: Reads a blob with no namespace field as production. That is the intuitive rule and it is wrong: the namespaced adapter shipped in #245 on 2026-08-25 at 18:13 while save.ts was last changed at 08:45 the same day, so ?dev=1&saveIo=1 has been exporting DEVELOPER data into unlabelled blobs ever since. Under this mutation such a blob imports into production without the warned action.
killedBy: save namespaces (issue #250) a blob with NO namespace is foreign, not assumed production
save namespaces (issue #250) allowForeignNamespace is the explicit action that lets either through
save namespaces (issue #250) an unrecognised namespace string is unknown, not malformed
